The test is checking whether a datetime index (`dti`) with timezone information ("Europe/Amsterdam") is retained when using `pivot_table()`. Therefore, the bug seems to be in how pandas handles timezone information when creating a pivot table from a DataFrame with datetime indexes. The `pivot_table()` method should preserve the tzinfo attribute of the DatetimeIndex during the operation.
